meta.title: SLATE grocery research, part two: vegetables, fruit, meat and pantry staples
meta.supplements: research-groceries.json (same product schema; same chains, endpoints, conventions and notes). This file adds products only; it repeats no product already in that file.
meta.method: Prices were read programmatically on 2026-10-01 from the same public endpoints as research-groceries.json: the Wynshop storefrontgateway preview search for Price Rite (store 301), Smart & Final (store 371), SuperValu (store 5550) and Save-On-Foods (store 937); Chedraui's VTEX catalog search; and Giant Tiger's Shopify products.json catalogue (read the same day into gt.tsv). Those rows have confirmed:true. Tesco and Sainsbury's rows come from Trolley.co.uk, a third-party tracker, because the chains block automated reads; they have confirmed:false. Where a product was on promotion the regular price is recorded and the promotional price is in the note. For variable-weight produce sold 'avg/ea', the per-kg or per-lb price is the chain's own unit price, or, when on sale, the regular average-item price divided by the chain's stated average weight (shown in the note).

fieldNotes.sizeQty: Converted to g, ml or ct (1 oz = 28.3495 g, 1 US fl oz = 29.5735 ml, 1 lb = 453.592 g), rounded to the nearest unit. Stock cubes are counted in cubes.
fieldNotes.pricedBy: 'each' = price for the stated pack or item; 'weight' = price per the stated weight (per lb or per kg) for loose or variable-weight items.
fieldNotes.taxIncluded: true for GB, IE and MX, where shelf prices include tax; false for US and CA, where food for home consumption is generally untaxed or zero-rated. No tax rates are asserted.
fieldNotes.storage: Assigned by the researcher from the product type, except where the chain's feed gave a storage type (SuperValu and Price Rite 'Frozen'/'Chilled'), which is followed; null where frozen-or-not could not be told.

gaps: US: no leeks at Smart & Final (Price Rite has organic bunch leeks only); no loose garlic or red lentils at Smart & Final (its "Lentils" are ordinary lentils and were not added); frozen berry medley storage at Smart & Final not stated by the feed. Dried apricots were not found at Price Rite or Smart & Final (dried cranberries given instead).

GB: no green-only Tesco chilli pack (Tesco mixed chillies given; Sainsbury's green chillies given). Tesco canned chopped tomatoes 400g used because Sainsbury's 227g is already in research-groceries.json; Tesco kidney beans and Sainsbury's chickpeas likewise already there. No Sainsbury's stock cubes added (the tracker's size, 10 g, was not credible for a pack). Sainsbury's loose broccoli, loose leeks, loose courgettes, button mushrooms loose and white turnips loose were skipped because the tracker gave prices that look per-kg without saying so. Sainsbury's lemons and white cabbage not returned. Tesco canned sweetcorn not added (only a 200 g item at £1.45 that looked like a multipack); Tesco Supersweet Sweetcorn 1kg not added because the tracker did not say frozen. Trolley.co.uk prices for loose items are given without a unit; they are recorded as each.

IE: SuperValu lists no separate swede; the Irish "turnip" (SuperValu Loose Turnip) is the swede, recorded once as turnip. No green-only chillies (mixed chillies given). SuperValu canned chickpeas are organic (Bunalun); no own-brand can was returned. SuperValu Chopped Tomatoes 400g is already in research-groceries.json, so Daily Basics was added.

CA: Save-On-Foods returned no plain green cabbage under "cabbage" (found under "cabbage green"); no green chillies other than jalapeño and serrano; the Sun-Maid raisins at Save-On-Foods are a six-box pack with no weight. Giant Tiger: no tomato paste, leeks, jalapeños, red lentils, canned kidney beans, sausages or stock cubes found in the catalogue rows read; broccoli omitted because its regional duplicates ranged $2.94 to $3.77 with no way to choose.

MX: no frozen mixed berries at Chedraui (frozen strawberries given); no canned kidney beans (frijol rojo/kidney returned nothing; Mexico's staple beans are negro, bayo and peruano); no red lentils (ordinary lentils given, marked); no dried apricots (dried cranberries given); no swede or turnip sought. Lemons: both the Eureka lemon and the Colima lime are given, since "limón" in Mexico means the lime. Chedraui produce by weight carries the site default seller price; branch prices can differ.
All markets: prices are one day's reading (2026-10-01); store-level prices vary.
